_meta.description: Sample holiday packages dataset for YatraSetu — modeled on fields used by MakeMyTrip, Yatra, and Thomas Cook.
_meta.note: Prices are realistic per-person estimates (twin sharing) based on typical market rates as of 2026. Image URLs use Picsum placeholder service (stable, always loads) — swap with real photos via the Unsplash API (unsplash.com/developers) before going live, e.g. query 'bali temple sunset' or 'kerala houseboat'.
